composition.value: Public domain as asserted in Commons’ separate musical-composition notice
composition.note: The notice cites Ives’s death in 1954 and publication before 1931, separately from the recording’s licence. Gann distinguishes 1920 printing and January 1921 circulation from the revised 1947 edition. Because the performing edition is unknown, later revisions and editorial additions are not independently cleared here. IMSLP marks the revised score non-public-domain in the United States.

sources.title: Kyle Gann — Following the Concord Sonata, Charles Ives Society
sources.locator: Thoreau section: introduction, walking episodes, A–C–G ostinato, late cyclic melody, optional flute and alternative without it, unresolved closing texture. Chronology distinguishes composition, editions and performance history.

sources.title: Charles Ives — Essays Before a Sonata
sources.locator: Thoreau essay: opening on listening beyond the concert room and concluding imagined autumn day at Walden, the walks, submission to nature, distant bell and flute. Ives’s own prose is distinguished from the modern editorial biographical sketch.
